text.en: Pet parents describe the sitters as trustworthy, kind, and willing to go the extra mile, including navigating tricky entry logistics or making visits during harsh winter weather. Clients note that regular caregivers build strong relationships with household pets, following specific feeding routines and care directions thoroughly.

title.en: Attentive companionship for dogs and cats

text.en: Owners frequently share that both dogs and cats appear relaxed, joyful, and well settled upon their return from work trips or family holidays. Reviewers appreciate the gentle handling provided to nervous rescues, older cats, and large multi-dog households, noting that animals eagerly greet their sitters whenever they arrive at the door.

Clients consistently praise the frequent text updates, detailed visit summaries, and daily photographs sent after each drop-in appointment. Pet owners express great reassurance knowing exactly how their companions are doing while away, highlighting prompt communication and quick answers to questions from the administrative team.

q.en: Does Sugar's Pet Sitting provide care for both dogs and cats?

a.en: Yes, caregivers look after both dogs and cats, offering midday dog walking, drop-in visits, and in-home care.

q.en: Do clients receive updates while away from home?

a.en: Yes, pet owners report receiving daily visit journals, photos, and messages detailing their pets' activities and meals.

q.en: Can the sitters accommodate multi-pet households?

a.en: Reviewers note that the team comfortably manages homes with multiple pets, including households with up to five dogs.
Clients mention that holiday bookings can be accommodated when reservations are scheduled well in advance.
